plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked dual-RNA vs chimeric single-guide RNA (sgRNA) Cas9 cleavage diagram from Deltcheva & Charpentier (31 Mar 2011 Nature 471: 602–607) and Jinek, Chylinski, Fonfara, Hauer, Doudna & Charpentier (28 Jun 2012 Science 337: 816–821) shows crRNA:tracrRNA fused into a single sgRNA with a customizable 20-nt 5' guide directing HNH and RuvC nuclease domains to cut both DNA strands 3 bp upstream of an NGG PAM.

teach_overlay.scale: the three-letter PAM sign acts like a safety catch on a pair of scissors — because the bacterium's own CRISPR mugshot album lacks that three-letter tag, Cas9 slices invading viruses to pieces without ever cutting its own DNA
